purpose: Independent human semantic review; evaluation-only, never a runtime prompt or a claim of model quality

cases.prompt: Synthetic Aurora reports 2025 revenue growth of 18%. A 2026 Q2 note predicts a slowdown but contains no quarterly result. Review whether the 2026 Q2 growth thesis is confirmed.
critical_checks: Do not present the forecast as an observed quarterly result

cases.prompt: Synthetic Harbor has USD 120 million parent revenue and CNY 300 million subsidiary revenue. Two Research Subjects share its Instrument but have different assumptions. Summarize evidence for only the subsidiary-margin Subject without an FX snapshot.
critical_checks: Keep the selected Subject and its assumption separate from the other Subject
Disclose missing margin and FX facts

cases.prompt: Synthetic Cedar price rose 4% on the same day as a product announcement. Sector prices also rose and no event study exists. Explain what the observation supports.
critical_checks: Retain sector movement as an alternative explanation

cases.prompt: Synthetic Lumen has improved weekly technical structure, weaker last-year margins, and no current-quarter filing. Review a current-quarter operating-margin hypothesis.
critical_checks: Technical structure does not establish operating margins
Do not dismiss contrary historical facts
State the temporal limitation of the counterevidence

cases.prompt: A synthetic Question is marked answered, its sole source is unavailable, and a later profitable trade is linked retrospectively. The original review selected a follow-up deadline. Decide whether the earlier process is proven improved.
critical_checks: Closed status and profit do not prove process improvement
Retrospective linking does not prove pre-trade intent
Preserve the source gap and request human review without creating or closing a task
